author: TEDx Talks
description:
When you need to make a decision, you might turn to AI for advice. But what really happens when we let algorithms decide for us? Computational social scientist Sandra Matz reveals how algorithms limit what you see, try, and ultimately become—and how to use AI to fuel your curiosity and expand your world.

 Sandra is a behavioral data scientist at Columbia Business School, investigating how digital footprints reveal psychological traits and influence real-world outcomes. By combining psychology and computer science, she advises global organizations, including Microsoft and the European Commission. As a DataIQ Top 100 honoree and Pacific Standard “Top Thinker Under 30,” her research has been published in leading scientific journals and featured by the BBC, CNBC, the Washington Post, and the World Economic Forum. 


This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Is AI making us boring? | Sandra Matz | TEDxNewEngland

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Llevamos décadas hablando de reformar la educación. De modernizarla. De adaptarla al siglo XXI. Pero, ¿y si el problema no es el sistema, sino lo que decidimos enseñar dentro de él? Carlos Julio lleva años en las aulas observando algo que la mayoría pasa por alto: hay competencias que no aparecen en ningún libro de texto, que no se evalúan en ningún examen, y que sin embargo son las que más lejos llevan a las personas. Las que construyen puentes entre el aula y el mundo real. Las que transforman alumnos en ciudadanos, y ciudadanos en agentes de cambio. En esta charla, Carlos desvela las 7 competencias que deberían estar en el centro de cualquier educación que aspire a transformar el mundo. No como teoría. Sino desde su propia experiencia, desde dentro de las aulas. Porque el futuro no se construye solo con conocimiento. Se construye con personas que saben usarlo.
 Profesional en Educación e Innovación Académica y doctorando en Innovación Educativa, con experiencia en el diseño y ejecu
title: Competencias: nacen cerca y transforman el mundo | Carlos Julio González Muñoz | TEDxCIS SFP Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this TEDx performance from Lagos, Algarve, Portugal, Rancho Folclórico e Etnográfico de Odiáxere brings the traditions of the western Algarve to the stage through folk dance, music, song and traditional dress. Their performance celebrates local heritage, community memory and the living culture of Odiáxere, keeping Algarve traditions alive through movement, rhythm and collective joy. Rancho Folclórico e Etnográfico de Odiáxere is a cultural group founded in March 1984 to preserve and share the customs, dances, songs and traditional costumes of the western Algarve.

Based in Odiáxere, near Lagos, the group has more than 50 active members and is known for recreating traditional dances and songs such as corridinhos, waltzes and mazurkas. Through authentic costumes, local characters and regular performances in Portugal and abroad, the group keeps the cultural heritage of the Barlavento Algarvio alive. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently
title: Algarve Folk Dance Performance | Rancho Folclórico e Etnográfico de Odiáxere | TEDxPraça Gil Eanes

author: TEDx Talks
description: Humor is often seen as a rare talent, something you either have or don’t. In this talk, Akash challenges that idea and shows how humor already exists in everyone’s life, rooted in lived experience, observation, and empathy. Drawing from stand-up comedy and science, he explores how laughter emerges from tension and why humor can be a powerful tool for connection. Especially in divisive times, humor can help us find unexpected common ground and remind us of our shared humanity. Akash Nair founded the Comedy Factory, Freiburg's first comedy club. His mission: to bring more stand-up comedy to Freiburg. At his workshops, you can learn how to be funny. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Everybody Can Be Funny | Akash Nair | TEDxFreiburg

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ali Arda’s talk explores why people tend to behave more aggressively in online spaces, examining how platform design and the absence of face‑to‑face cues shape our reactions. He invites us to pause before we type and choose kindness, reminding us that there is a real person behind every screen. I am a middle school student in Istanbul. I am passionate about many things, the world interests me and I love sharing fun facts with others. I decided to join TEDx to share my ideas about the reason why people are agressive on the internet, rather than spreading kindness instead. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

description:
Innovatoren sind Problemlöser – und lieben nichts mehr als konkrete Herausforderungen. 

Wenn wir planetare Herausforderungen als Ausgangspunkt unserer Innovationsreise begreifen, können wir die Kraft von Innovation nutzen, um Gutes zu bewirken – und gleichzeitig die Zukunftsfähigkeit unserer Unternehmen sichern. 

Nachhaltigkeit wird so zum strategischen Innovationsfeld und die Wirtschaft zum Motor der grünen Transformation. Nachhaltigkeit ist weit mehr als CSRD, CO₂-Bilanzen oder Klimaneutralität. Nachhaltigkeit ist der Innovationstreiber unserer Zeit. Steffen Erath ist Head of Innovation & Sustainability bei Hansgrohe SE und verantwortet den Innovationsbereich des Unternehmens. Er gründete das Hansgrohe InnoLab, das 2022 und 2023 von Capital als bestes Innovation Lab Deutschlands ausgezeichnet wurde. Mit der Kraft der Innovation treibt er die grüne Transformation von Hansgrohe maßgeblich voran. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently or

Before you ask what something means, there is a moment when you simply see it. A dancer from Russia, now living in China, explores that gap between knowing and experiencing, following the movement hidden inside paintings, calligraphy, and martial arts. Her argument, drawn from Daoist thought: sensation comes first, meaning comes later. Flowing, flexible, alive. DARIA (郭宁澈) is a Russian interdisciplinary movement artist based in Chengdu and currently completing her degree at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. Her practice combines contemporary dance, culture, traditional Chinese martial arts, and visual art research to explore perception, embodiment, and cultural connection.
She has participated in performance and volunteer art initiatives at Chengdu Art Museum, Chengdu Biennale, and Chengdu Fuxing Art Center. She was also invited as a performer for many dance events and shared her percpective of art.
Through movement, DARIA explores how art can become a bridge between p

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Bei ADHS denken viele an „schlimme Jungs“: laut, frech, Grenzen sprengend. Doch bei Frauen
sieht ADHS oft anders aus: subtiler, nach innen gerichtet und häufig maskiert. Das Resultat: eine
ständige Spannung zwischen innerem Hochdruck und den Erwartungen an Ruhe, Planbarkeit und
Funktionieren. Dr. Susanne Löffner, Ärztin, Stressmedizinerin und Stresscoach, wurde selbst erst mit 48 Jahren mit ADHS diagnostiziert. In ihrem Talk verbindet sie ihre persönlichen Erfahrungen mit wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen. Sie erklärt, wie ADHS sich bei Frauen zeigt, welche Herausforderungen damit einhergehen und welche Chancen sie bietet. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Unerkannt. Unverstanden. Unbeliebt. ADHS bei Frauen | Dr. Susanne Löffner | TEDxFreiburg

author: TEDx Talks
description: Echter Kontrollverlust für uns alle – und ein rechtsfreier Raum? Stephanie Beyrich's Talk zeigt: Wir stehen mit dem rasendem technologischem Fortschritt zwischen menschlicher Kontrolle und künstlicher Intelligenz. Jetzt zeigt sich, wohin wir als Gesellschaft eigentlich wollen: Was können wir gewinnen, was können wir aber auch verlieren? Stephanie Beyrich wird von ihrer Community liebevoll „Orkan der Rechtspflege“ genannt. Wikimedia Deutschland hat ihr den Ehrentitel „Monster of Law“ verliehen. Sie ist Rechtsanwältin, Autorin und Moderatorin. Seit über 5 Jahren ist sie Podcasterin und Host der vieler Formate wie „Jura & Trash“, „ALL EYES ON“ und „(R)ECHT INTERESSANT!“. author: TEDx Talks
description:
From glowing oceans visible from space to fireflies and luminous fungi, nature has developed countless ways to generate “cold light” with remarkable efficiency. In his talk, Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Stefan Schramm demonstrates how these natural principles can serve as a blueprint for sustainable technologies in the form of BioLEMs. These organic, metal-free light-emitting molecules may illuminate future displays without placing a burden on the environment.
His core idea is simple yet powerful: instead of fighting against the limits of nature, we can learn from it how to store and release energy more gently. In this way, our cities at night could one day shine more like living ecosystems — and less like industrial byproducts. A fascinating look at the future of light – color-accurate, highly efficient, sustainable, and biologically inspired Stefan Schramm ist ein deutscher Chemiker und Professor für organische Chemie an der Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft Dresden. Seine Forschung konz
title: Living Light – What Bioluminescence Teaches Us  | Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Stefan Schramm | TEDxFreiburg

author: TEDx Talks
description: In diesem Talk erzählt Marian Veith seine außergewöhnliche Geschichte – eine Geschichte über das Umgehen von Widrigkeiten, das Akzeptieren tiefgreifender Veränderungen und darüber, wie man auch in den schwersten Momenten motiviert bleibt. Offen, ehrlich und inspirierend zeigt er, wie aus einem scheinbaren Ende ein neuer Anfang entstehen kann. Schon als Jugendlicher war Marian Veith aus Denzlingen Dauergast auf dem Feldberg. Skifahren war sein Leben. Doch 2022 ändert sich alles: Eine Lawine begräbt ihn. Marian überlebt nur knapp. Der Unfall kostet ihn sein Bein, aber nicht seine Lebenslust. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Ohne Limits – Verlust, Neubeginn und Hindernisse überwinden | Marian Veith | TEDxFreiburg

author: TEDx Talks
description: Was bleibt, wenn die gemeinsame Zeit begrenzt ist? Judith Grümmer erzählt, wie aus einer einfachen Idee ein außergewöhnliches Sozialunternehmen entstand, das unheilbar erkrankten Eltern eine Stimme gibt. Sie berichtet von bewegenden Begegnungen, der Kraft des autobiografischen Erzählens und davon, warum persönliche Geschichten für Kinder oft das wertvollste Vermächtnis sind. Ein inspirierender Talk über Erinnerung, Menschlichkeit und die Bedeutung des Zuhörens – auch in den schwersten Momenten des Lebens. Judith Grümmer ist Gründerin der Familienhörbuch gGmbH, die sie 2019 ins Leben gerufen hat. Mit ihrem Sozialunternehmen ermöglicht sie unheilbar erkrankten Müttern und Vätern, ihre Lebensgeschichte als professionell produziertes Hörbuch festzuhalten. Die entstehenden Familienhörbücher bewahren Erinnerungen, Werte und persönliche Botschaften für die Kinder und schaffen ein bleibendes Vermächtnis. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently org
title: Was ich dir noch erzählen wollte… | Judith Grümmer | TEDxFreiburg

What happens when growing up happens too soon? At just 11, May faced a life-changing diagnosis: Central Precocious Puberty (CPP), a condition that made her grow up faster than her peers—both physically and emotionally. 
In this heartfelt talk, she sheds light on the overlooked struggles of children with CPP, from managing stigma and bullying to navigating invisible emotional burdens. 
Through her story, May calls for greater empathy, awareness, and support for children facing misunderstood medical conditions. 青少年心理健康倡导者 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

The battlefield has evolved from bronze swords to digital arenas, but have the core tenets of conflict changed? Shrewsbury House School pupil Alexander N. provides a brilliant historical analysis of the Trojan War, mapping ancient tactical paradigms directly onto contemporary military strategy. His presentation highlights the enduring nature of human conflict and the value of historical literacy in understanding modern global crises.

Through the I.C.O.N. idea-Intelligence Comes Often through Nonconformity - the speaker argues that diverse voices, minority perspectives, African thought, cultural memory, creativity, and unconventional knowledge are essential to meaningful innovation. title: Intelligence in Nonconformity | Professor Celestine Iwendi | TEDxUniversity of Greater Manchester

description:
Every moment holds more than one possible tomorrow. In this insightful talk, Shivangi Bajpai explores how awareness helps us recognize the different paths that exist before us. She reflects on choosing purpose over predictability and shares how growth often begins when we allow ourselves to evolve. Through lessons drawn from change and observation, she reminds us that true empowerment comes from recognizing our choices and consciously deciding which future to create.
Shivangi Bajpai is an acclaimed Indian wildlife photographer whose work captures powerful stories from the natural world. Through her lens, she inspires awareness, empathy and a deeper connection with wildlife and conservation. Her work goes beyond photography, encouraging people to see nature not only with their eyes but also with a greater sense of responsibility and understanding.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Every story has a scene that seems insignificant in the moment, only to reveal later that it changed everything.
For Ritik Ghansani, it was a simple sentence: "I want to act." In this honest and personal talk, he reflects on the small choices that shaped his journey from a small-town dreamer to an actor. Through stories of struggle and self-doubt, he explores how our lives are quietly connected by the choices we make. His message is simple yet powerful: if small choices can shape our lives unconsciously, they can also reshape them consciously. Because a thousand tomorrows are not waiting somewhere in the future. They are being built by the choices we make today.
Ritik Ghansani is an Indian actor, storyteller and performer known for his work across film and digital platforms including Bada Naam Karenge, Sky Force, and Dil Dosti Dilemma. Through his performances, he brings honesty and emotional depth to stories that celebrate resilience, hope  and the beauty of being human.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sometimes the biggest changes begin with a simple question: What if there is another way? In this heartfelt talk, Neha Marda reflects on the choices that shaped her journey through reinvention, loss, motherhood and entrepreneurship. She shares how life's turning points rarely come with certainty and how awareness often begins when we question the things we have learned to accept without pause. Through her experiences, she reminds us that every moment holds more than one possibility and that a different future becomes real only when we choose to see it.
Neha Marda is a renowned Indian television actress known for her impactful roles in popular shows like Balika Vadhu and Doli Armaano Ki. Over the years, she has earned recognition for portraying strong and relatable characters on screen. Expanding beyond acting, she has also stepped into entrepreneurship, building ventures that reflect her creative vision. Her journey represents growth, reinvention, and the courage to explore new paths
title: Moving Beyond Expectations | Neha Marda | TEDxKIET

Behind every story that inspires others lies a quiet act of perseverance. In this inspiring talk, Stuti Changle reflects on what it takes for an idea to become something meaningful. She shares how every story begins as a possibility and survives only when someone chooses to keep going through doubt, rejection and uncertainty. She explores how perseverance helps a story grow from a simple possibility into something that can reach and inspire others. 
Stuti Changle is a nationally bestselling Indian author and storyteller whose work explores self-discovery, courage and the pursuit of one's true calling. Best known for You Only Live Once and Stars Will Guide You Home, she has captivated over a million readers through stories that resonate deeply with today's generation. Through heartfelt narratives and relatable characters, she captures the dreams and aspirations that shape the journey of becoming.

In this thought-provoking talk, Professor Paul Hollins challenges the common perception that games are merely entertainment or a distraction from the “real world.” Drawing on his own experiences with failure and academic research, he argues that play is a powerful tool for learning, inclusion, creativity, and innovation.

Professor Hollins explores how digital games create spaces where people are judged by their actions rather than their background or abilities, making them uniquely inclusive environments. He highlights the extraordinary scale of the global games industry and demonstrates how gaming platforms can engage millions of people in meaningful conversations about society’s biggest challenges.

Through examples from his research, including international projects, he shows how games have enabled participants from almost every country in the world to collaborate, express their views, and contribute to solutions on issues ranging from sustainability to resource management. His wo
title: Games as a Force for Good | Professor Paul Hollins | TEDxUniversity of Greater Manchester

Discover how biology, environment, relationships, and personal choices interact to shape who we are, revealing a hopeful truth that being human is not about a fixed blueprint, but a lifelong process of becoming. Gurchetan Kaur is a dedicated and articulate student, known for her strong communication skills and passion for learning, she actively participates in academic and co-curricular activities. She has a keen interest in reading, public speaking, and scientific exploration, particularly in biotechnology and emerging innovations. description: Tarun Kapoor reveals how plant breeding has quietly transformed civilisations, feeding billions and shaping the future of food security. From ancient farmers selecting better crops to modern breakthroughs in biofortified wheat, he uncovers the science hidden inside every grain we eat. Discover how innovation, patience, and nature’s genetic diversity may hold the key to solving hidden hunger and nourishing future generations, one seed at a time. Because, one of humanity’s greatest innovations isn’t a machine, but a seed. Tarun Kapoor is a researcher and educator whose work explores the intersection of genetics, biotechnology, and sustainable agriculture. Driven by a deep curiosity about how living systems function, he focuses on understanding the role of genetic diversity in developing crops that are more resilient, nutritious, and capable of meeting future food demands. Gurnoor Singh Bhangoo explores the intersection of science, empathy, and moral responsibility. Challenging conventional views on animal welfare, he examines how emerging insights into animal emotions could reshape ethical decision-making in research and biotechnology. Through a compelling blend of scientific inquiry and ethical reflection, this talk invites us to reconsider what responsible innovation truly means in an increasingly advanced world.  Gurnoor Singh is an ambitious student known for blending scientific curiosity with art along with thoughtful conversations. He also has a growing interest in biotechnology, ethics and human centric conversations, he believes ideas become powerful when they connect emotionally as well as intellectually. author: TEDx Talks
description:
A Californian who grew up on Long Island, Ellen first arrived in Paris in 1991 as part of an exchange program between The Wharton School and Sciences Po. She was supposed to stay for a year. She never left.

Her talk is about the quiet, powerful relationship that teachers build with their students. That daily confrontation with the reality of a new generation a generation that, often without realizing it, pushes the "grown-ups" to question themselves. To adapt. To grow.

For Ellen, a Growth Mindset isn't a pose. It's what actually happens, day after day, inside a classroom. When the roles reverse. When certainties start to crack. When you finally accept that becoming antifragile means accepting that you have something to learn from the very people you're supposed to be teaching. Ellen has been a permanent faculty member at INSEEC MSc for over ten years. She's the author of Portraits of VEEP: The Incredible Story of Kamala Harris (Librinova, 2022), and a recognized thought expert on U.
title: “PARIS, ABROAD : FOR THE EXPAT CURIOUS” | Ellen KOUNTZ | TEDxINSEEC

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do some people wait for the future while others create it? Through the story behind Education RASA, in this talk Rabia Haidari explores how a simple shift from waiting to taking ownership can transform ideas into action. Reflecting on failures and lessons learned, she argues that the future is not something handed to us but something we shape through responsibility, courage, continuous learning, and the willingness to begin before we feel ready.
 Rabia Haidari is an education activist, youth leader, and Founder of Education RASA, an initiative committed to making education accessible to girls and underserved communities. Through online learning, mentorship, and leadership development, she has empowered hundreds of young people with the knowledge and skills needed to shape their futures. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks

Why do we spend so much time waiting, for the right moment, better circumstances, or someone else to change our lives?
In this talk, Fawad Saeedi shares his journey from launching a small educational initiative as a university student to helping thousands of young people access learning and opportunities. Through personal stories from education and community development, he explores how meaningful change begins when individuals take responsibility, act on their ideas, and start building solutions instead of waiting for them. Fawad Saeedi is the Founder of Gem Online Academy and an advocate for education, youth growth, and skills development. Through his initiatives, he has worked to create accessible learning opportunities and inspire youths to pursue personal and professional growth. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
